title: Alphabet invests in Safe Superintelligence

sources.quote: Alphabet and Nvidia have invested in Safe Superintelligence (SSI), the stealth-mode AI startup co-founded by former OpenAI chief scientist Ilya Sutskever, sources told Reuters.

explain: Alphabet invested an undisclosed amount in Safe Superintelligence, Ilya Sutskever's AI lab, around a funding round that valued it at $32 billion. This comes from sources speaking to Reuters, not the companies.
